source_record.finding: Composition examination exposed a real omitted receiving premise. EA11's enforced exposure boundary depends on actual propagation/interface meaning. The prior orientation map omitted critical_dependency among its receiving uses, so two conditional native interfaces were incorrectly left unresolved. This is not lack of a live target execution. The two source mechanisms can qualify the exposure/independence premise at a conditional same-system guard without proving that the boundary is enforced or that exposure is safe.

directions.argument: Critical lower-tier and common-cause dependency information can identify a propagation or shared-failure path across the proposed exposure boundary. The particular information changes whether a nominal one-instance or independent-cohort claim is warranted, even though a map does not itself isolate instances or supply recovery. This is a useful input to the exposure premise, not a requirement to prove whole release safety.
directions.guard: The mapped dependency actually participates in the proposed exposed system and matters for the specific failure/propagation claim; establish the mapping's identity and relevant scope. Actual enforcement, harmful effects, recovery, outcome value and authority remain separate.
directions.counter: A generic supplier map unrelated to that propagation path contributes nothing. Two independently named cohorts may still share the failed dependency; conversely an actually isolated population can remain bounded even when recovery is unavailable.

directions.argument: The negotiated actual interface semantics and integration responsibility can reveal whether a change or failure propagates from the exposed cohort into another system. That qualifies the claimed exposure boundary and can require a different partition or limit. The useful contribution is the interface/propagation premise, not the assertion that agreement or a passed local test enforces isolation.
directions.guard: The identified interface and versions cross the proposed exposure boundary and the semantics concern the actual failure mode. A real integration observation or adequate analysis must justify the relevant correspondence; unrelated interfaces do not activate the relation.
directions.counter: A signed interface contract may disagree with actual integration, and two correct local endpoints may still produce cross-boundary effects. A genuinely isolated interface can support the narrow population bound without proving restoration, acceptable loss, value or permission.
